Next.js

Build service websites and applications on a coherent structure.

NOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Next.js is a React framework for building websites and web applications. We can combine public service pages, product interfaces, and server-side application logic within a coherent project structure. For a client, that can mean an informative marketing website connected to a secure portal, with planned loading states, metadata, forms, and a maintainable route hierarchy.

Useful outputs

  • Responsive route-based website or application
  • Server-side actions and validated forms
  • Deployment configuration and operating guide

Where we can apply it

  • Service website: content hierarchy → responsive pages → enquiry workflow.
  • Client portal: authentication → authorized account view → project updates.
  • SaaS launch: product journeys → application routes → measured onboarding.
01

Use case 1

Build a multi-page service website with clear navigation and page metadata.

02

Use case 2

Create customer portals and SaaS interfaces connected to authorized backend data.

03

Use case 3

Implement validated forms and server-side endpoints for business workflows.

Inputs we need

  • Approved page architecture and content
  • Authentication and backend requirements
  • Performance and device acceptance criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Define public and authenticated routes and their data requirements.
  • Implement reusable interfaces, server boundaries, and error states.
  • Check representative journeys, performance, and production deployment behavior.

Expert review points

  • Review authentication and authorization on protected routes.
  • Confirm server-only credentials never enter client bundles.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
